record.paper_title: Five open problems in theory of quantum information
record.original_question: Show that the two-ququart Werner state ρ(4,−1/2) is not 2-copy distillable. Equivalently, prove that for every Kronecker sum A⊕B = A⊗I + I⊗B with traceless 4×4 matrices A and B satisfying Tr(A†A)+Tr(B†B)=1/4, the sum of squares of the two largest singular values is at most 1/2.

evidence.quote: Problem 5: Show that the Werner stateρ(4,−1/2) of two ququarts,d = 4, defined in Eq. (5) below, is not 2-copy distillable.

A distinguished state of this family,ρ(4,−1/2), appearing in the problem considered here, is the only two-ququart Werner state such that its partial transpose (see Eq. 4) is proportional to a unitary matrix.

Interestingly, thisquestionisalso equivalent to the following algebraic problem [134]: Show that the sum of squares of the two largest singular values is bounded by1/2 for any Kronecker (tensor) sum, A⊕ B= A⊗ 1 l+ 1 l⊗ B, where A and B denote traceless matrices of size4 satisfying Tr(A†A)+ Tr(B†B)= 1/4.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $d=4$ and let $\mathbb{F}\in M_d\otimes M_d$ denote the swap (flip) operator $\mathbb{F}|i\rangle|j\rangle=|j\rangle|i\rangle$. The two-ququart Werner state with parameter $f=-1/2$ is
$$\rho(4,-1/2)=\frac{1}{d^2-d\cdot(-1/2)\cdot 2}\bigl(I-2\cdot(-1/2)\,\mathbb{F}\bigr)\cdot c,$$
normalized to a density operator (equivalently, the unique two-ququart Werner state whose partial transpose is proportional to a unitary). A bipartite state $\rho$ on $\mathbb{C}^d\otimes\mathbb{C}^d$ is called $n$-copy distillable if there exists a Schmidt-rank-2 vector $|\psi\rangle\in(\mathbb{C}^d)^{\otimes n}\otimes(\mathbb{C}^d)^{\otimes n}$ such that $\langle\psi|(\rho^{\otimes n})^{T_B}|\psi\rangle<0$, where $T_B$ denotes the partial transpose on the second factor.

Prove that $\rho(4,-1/2)$ is not $2$-copy distillable.

Equivalently, prove the following algebraic statement: for every pair of traceless complex $4\times 4$ matrices $A,B\in M_4(\mathbb{C})$ satisfying
$$\operatorname{Tr}(A^\dagger A)+\operatorname{Tr}(B^\dagger B)=\tfrac{1}{4},$$
the Kronecker sum $A\oplus B := A\otimes I_4 + I_4\otimes B$ has its two largest singular values $\sigma_1\ge\sigma_2$ satisfying
$$\sigma_1^2+\sigma_2^2 \le \tfrac{1}{2}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The two-copy distillability problem for the 4×4 Werner state ρ(4,−1/2) remains an open conjecture in quantum information theory. Partial results have been established: Chen and collaborators (2021) proved the conjecture for monomial matrices A, B, and a 2023 follow-up extended this to matrices A, B with at most four nonzero entries. No general proof is known as of 2026.

status_evidence.title: Proving the distillability problem of two-copy 4×4 Werner states for monomial matrices
status_evidence.snippet: Three special cases of the conjecture have been proven in terms of the 4×4 non-normal matrices A, B... main result occurring when A, B are monomial matrices.
status_evidence.claim: Partial result: conjecture proved when A, B are monomial matrices.

status_evidence.title: On the distillability problem of two-copy 4×4 Werner states: matrices A, B of at most four nonzero entries
status_evidence.snippet: the problem is partially solved when the involved 4×4 matrices A and B have one and three nonzero entries, and as a corollary, the problem is solved when A and B have at most four nonzero entries.
status_evidence.claim: Further partial progress in 2023 for matrices with up to four nonzero entries; full conjecture remains open.
